title: Node-RED Flow Timeout Hotspots
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST - forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nodered:event level=error
| where match(message,"(?i)timeout")
| stats count as timeout_errors by flow_name
| where timeout_errors>0
| sort - timeout_errors
description: Highlights the Node-RED flows most associated with timeout errors so you can focus on the integrations that are actually slowing the whole graph down.
value: Complex flow graphs fail at their slowest node; a timeout leaderboard helps you optimize the right endpoint instead of guessing.
implementation: Forward Node-RED runtime errors; schedule daily and inspect the flows generating the most timeout-related failures.
visualization: Leaderboard of flows by timeout error count.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which of your visual automation flows keep timing out and slowing everything else down.
